lines: An agent's email draft is sent exactly as written, to the people it's addressed to, never cut short.
Memory search and recall work again on Spaces made before rc.18.
The model you pick in a chat is the one that runs. If it can't run here, the chat says why and offers another.
Naming someone who isn't in the chat no longer silences the agent. It answers, and the message box says who it will reach.
Reconnecting a calendar no longer makes a second copy, and goal helpers join the goal's chat.
Artifacts show in the desktop app again instead of a blank page, and the @mention highlight stays on the name in long drafts.
